newsitem.title: UK: Ghana weekly purchases drop, cumulative behind 95/.
newsitem.headline: Ghana weekly purchases drop, cumulative behind 95/.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the 14th week of the current 1996/97 season ending January 16 amounted to 15,614 tonnes compared with 8,798 tonnes in the corresponding period of 1995/96, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Tuesday.
The latest figure signals a drop in weekly purchases. They otalled 16,364 tonnes in the 13th week ending January 9.

Cumulative purchases were 245,368 tonnes against 296,064 tonnes by January 18 last year which corresponded to the 15th week of the 1995/96 campaign. By the end of the 14-week, total purchases were running at 287,266 tonnes last year.
